templates.title: Coder
templates.name: coder
templates.description: Coder v2.36.7 is a self-hosted development-platform control plane with Postgres and a Docker socket for workspace templates.

env.name: CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL
env.label: CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL
env.description: Postgres connection URL. User, password, host, and database match the database service.

env.name: CODER_HTTP_ADDRESS
env.label: CODER_HTTP_ADDRESS
env.description: Address the Coder control plane listens on inside the container.

env.name: CODER_ACCESS_URL
env.label: CODER_ACCESS_URL
env.description: URL that users and workspaces use to reach Coder. Localhost works for Docker templates on this host only.

env.name: POSTGRES_USER
env.label: POSTGRES_USER
env.description: Postgres role created on first start.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.description: Postgres password. The same value is embedded in CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL.

env.name: POSTGRES_DB
env.label: POSTGRES_DB
env.description: Postgres database created on first start.
